## Hosted compile failure on the toolchain update

[PR #97](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/pull/97) updates the development SDK from 2026.11.4 to 2026.11.6. At head `bd0bb15f3eccd554b92f2c241de27eab5e080cc6`, both the [Node 22 job](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/42601265379/job/129106055783) and [Bun release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/42601265379/job/129106055387) stop at TypeScript compilation:

```text
sync.ts(769,44): error TS2345:
... is not assignable to
WithNullClears<DeclaredProperties<CreateCommandOptions>, CreateNullClearableOptionKey>
Types of property 'closeReason' are incompatible.
Type 'string | null | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string | undefined'.
```

The hosted jobs tested synthetic merge `d8a066245784123c806c758d4460a33ce37553b8`, combining that candidate with base `983f6ae1622a1babed91a9280cd32f6456fc4acd`. This is hosted test evidence, not an independent local reproduction.

## Static explanation

[pmFields](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/bd0bb15f3eccd554b92f2c241de27eab5e080cc6/sync.ts) advertises `PmUpdateActionOptions & { field: string[] }`. The [new-item import path](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/bd0bb15f3eccd554b92f2c241de27eab5e080cc6/sync.ts#L766-L770) spreads that update-shaped result into `pm.create`. Setting `unset: undefined` does not narrow every update-only or nullable property admitted by the return type.

The actual mapper does not emit closeReason in the inspected implementation. This report therefore does not claim a runtime null is sent, or that the newer SDK's create/update distinction is itself a defect. The adapter needs a truthful create-compatible type/conversion without losing the update path's semantics.

## Expected behavior and impact

The typed Azure import adapter should compile against its selected development SDK and preserve correct new-item creation and existing-item updates. Actual: `npm run typecheck` / `bun run typecheck` exits 1, preventing this dependency update from reaching the behavioral and release gates.

Relevant accepted validation is recorded in [pm-ado-toolchain-1104](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/bd0bb15f3eccd554b92f2c241de27eab5e080cc6/.agents/pm/chores/pm-ado-toolchain-1104.toon): meaningful contract assertions, current generated output, typecheck, package tests and unchanged coverage/rollback checks. The shared SDK remains the semantic owner; do not recreate SDK null-clear rules in the adapter.

Scope is the unmerged #97 build. No released-package regression, live Azure failure or data loss is established.

## Acceptance / regression criteria

- Express the mapper's actual emitted field subset or separate supported create/update input construction; avoid `any`, blanket casts or weakening compiler checks.
- Preserve existing-item explicit-clear behavior, new-item creation, provenance fields and native revision/history guards.
- Run `npm ci` with the committed lock, `npm run typecheck`, build/source-and-built sync tests, and the unchanged Node 22/26 plus npm/Bun release gates on the corrected immutable head.
- Add a compile-time regression for passing mapped new-item fields to the public SDK create method, and a behavioral new-Azure-item import check with no live provider.
- Record candidate/merge/runtime revisions and distinguish passing compilation from full gate success.

Deduplication checked all-status repository issues and PRs, #97 conversation, and all 54 canonical tracker item documents at this head. Closed #67 concerns a different GetItemProjection fixture mismatch and is not this failure. No matching current owner for this create/update input mismatch was found.
